holderName.description: The full name of the cardholder as it appears on the card.

expiryMonth.description: The two-digit expiration month of the card.

expiryYear.description: The four-digit expiration year of the card.

validate.description: If included, PPRO will try to validate the instrument with a nominal-amount authorization. If validation fails, the instrument creation request will fail

taxIdentification.description: The consumer's tax identification number, like CUIT in Argentina, CPF in Brazil, RUT in Chile, NIF in Spain or Portugal, Numéro fiscal in France, and Codice Fiscale in Italy, or the equivalent tax identifier applicable in the consumer's country.

instrumentUpdateDetails.description: Additional details to update an existing instrument. Must be used together with instrumentId.

cvv.description: Card Verification Value used to authenticate the card during a payment.

value.description: The monetary value to be charged or processed, expressed in the smallest currency unit (e.g., cents for EUR).

currency.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the currency in which the amount is denominated

consumer.description: Defines the details of the consumer.

name.description: The full name of the consumer making the payment.

email.description: The email address of the consumer making the payment.

phone.description: The phone number of the consumer making the payment.

birthDate.description: The date of birth of the consumer making the payment.

country.description: The country of residence of the consumer, represented as a two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

locale.description: The locale of the consumer in the format of a language and country code.

ip.description:
The IP address of the client initiating the payment request.
Must be a valid IPv4 or IPv6 address.

userAgent.description: The User-Agent string from the client’s HTTP request header.
userAgent.example: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; CrOS x86_64 8172.45.0) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/51.0.2704.64 Safari/537.36

taxIdentification.description: The consumer's tax identification number, like CUIT in Argentina, CPF in Brazil, RUT in Chile, NIF in Spain or Portugal, Numéro fiscal in France, and Codice Fiscale in Italy, or the equivalent tax identifier applicable in the consumer's country.

billingAddress.description: Defines the billing address of the consumer.

firstName.description: The first name of the individual associated with the address.

lastName.description: The last name of the individual associated with the address.

phoneNumber.description: The phone number of the individual associated with the address.

street.description: The street name and number of the address.

country.description: The country of the address, represented as a two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

createdDate.description: The date when the consumer profile was created.

lifetimeOrderCount.description: The consumer’s total number of orders.

lifetimeOrderValue.description: The consumer’s total value of orders, expressed in the smallest currency unit.

lifetimeCanceledOrderCount.description: The consumer’s total number of cancelled orders.

order.description: Defines order information, including purchased items and associated shipping details.

sku.description: The Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) that uniquely identifies the product in the order.

category.description: The category or classification of the product or service in the order.

subCategory.description: The sub category or classification of the product or service in the order.

name.description: The product or service name in the order.

quantity.description: The product or service quantity in the order.

amount.description: The monetary value of the individual product or service, expressed in the smallest currency unit (e.g., cents for EUR).

shippingMethod.description: Digital goods/services: VIRTUAL, Physical goods:TRACKED_DELIVERY, UNTRACKED_DELIVERY, IN_STORE_PICKUP, LOCKER_PICKUP or HYBRID

shippingAddress.description: Defines the shipping address of the consumer.

firstName.description: The first name of the individual associated with the address.

lastName.description: The last name of the individual associated with the address.

phoneNumber.description: The phone number of the individual associated with the address.

street.description: The street name and number of the address.

country.description: The country of the address, represented as a two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

pnr.description: The Passenger Name Record (PNR) associated with the airline booking.

numberOfPassengers.description: The number of passengers on the booking.

airlineCode.description: The standardized two-letter or three-letter airline code assigned by IATA (International Air Transport Association) or ICAO (International Civil Aviation Organization).

passengerEmail.description: The email address of the passenger.

carrierCode.description: The standardized two-letter or three-letter carrier code assigned by IATA (International Air Transport Association) or ICAO (International Civil Aviation Organization).

fareBasisCode.description: The fare basis code is an alphanumeric identifier used by airlines to specify the fare rules, booking class, and restrictions associated with a ticket.

departureAirportCode.description: The three-letter IATA airport code representing the departure airport for the flight.

destinationAirportCode.description: The three-letter IATA airport code representing the destination airport for the flight.

departureDate.description: The departure date of the flight.

flightCarrierCode.description: The two-letter IATA airline code representing the carrier operating the flight.

segmentId.description: A unique identifier for a specific flight segment within a booking or itinerary.

postHighSchoolCourse.description: Whether the course is post high school?

departureLocation.description: Departure location, if flight then provide IATA Airport Code

arrivalLocation.description: Arrival location, if flight then provide IATA Airport Code

buyerAmongTravelers.description: Is the buyer consumer among travelers?

travelCanBeModifiedOrCanceled.description: Can the travel be modified or canceled?

orderReferenceNumber.description: A merchant-defined identifier (e.g., invoice or order number) that remains the same across all payment attempts for the same order.

totalTaxAmount.description:
The total tax amount for the order.
Same currency as specified in `amount.currency`.

installmentPlan.description: The number of installments the consumer will split the payment into.

numberOfInstallments.description: The number of installments the consumer will split the payment into.

feePaidBy.description: Indicates which party bears the installment fees (e.g.: for BNPL installments).

merchantPaymentChargeReference.description: A merchant-defined identifier that uniquely represents a single payment attempt.

returnUrl.description: The URL to which the consumer is redirected after completing an action, such as a payment or authentication flow.

externalAcsId.description: The 3DS universally unique transaction identifier assigned by the ACS to identify a single transaction. Canonical format as defined in IETF RFC 4122.

cancellationReason.description: The 3DS challenge cancellation indicator.Mandatory for CB transactions.

outOfScope.description: The 3DS out of scope object, to be used if the payment is out of scope of SCA

reason.description: The 3DS out of scope reason, to be used to indicate the reason if the payment is out of scope of SCA

returnUrl.description: The URL to which the consumer is redirected after completing the 3D Secure authentication flow.

scanBy.description: The date and time at which the associated code expires. Must be provided in ISO 8601 format.

verificationCode.description: Code generated to authenticate the user.

mobileIntentUri.description: A mobile deep link or intent URI to which the consumer is redirected after completing an action, such as a payment or authentication flow.

instrumentProviderIdentity.description: App identifier, for instance email, phone number

autoCapture.description: Indicates whether the payment charge should be automatically captured after a successful authorization.

webhooksUrl.description: The URL to which the payment charge state changes will be notified.

labels.description: Custom labels associated with the payment charge.
labels.title: Add Labels

tools.name: GET_PAYMENT_CHARGE
tools.description: Retrieves a Payment Charge by Payment Charge ID and Merchant ID

tools.name: LIST_PAYMENT_CHARGES
tools.description: Searches Payment Charges by exactly one of Merchant Payment Charge Reference or Agreement ID for a given Merchant ID. The result may include a nextPage parameter, which indicates that there are more pages to fetch that match the search criteria. In order to fetch the next page, the value obtained in nextPage should be used in the page parameter of the subsequent request

tools.name: UPDATE_PAYMENT_CHARGE_AUTHORIZATION
tools.description: Provide additional data required to proceed with the Payment Charge authorization

confirmationRequest.description: The Payment Charge authorization update details

authenticationResult.description: The outcome of processing the payment authentication challenge (eg: a payment provider generated token or a 3DS challenge response).

details.description: A map containing the authentication result details which format is understood by the payment processor of the associated payment method

tools.name: GET_PAYMENT_CHARGE_AUTHORIZATION
tools.description: Retrieves a Payment Charge Authorization by Payment Charge ID, Authorization ID and Merchant ID

tools.name: LIST_PAYMENT_CHARGE_AUTHORIZATIONS
tools.description: Retrieves the Payment Charge Authorizations by Payment Charge ID and Merchant ID

tools.name: CAPTURE_PAYMENT_CHARGE
tools.description: Capture all or part of an authorization on a Payment Charge

amount.description: The capture amount in the payment charge currency's smallest unit.

labels.description: Custom labels associated with the capture.

tools.name: GET_PAYMENT_CHARGE_CAPTURE
tools.description: Retrieves a Payment Charge Capture by Payment Charge ID, Capture ID and Merchant ID

tools.name: LIST_PAYMENT_CHARGE_CAPTURES
tools.description: Retrieves the Payment Charge Captures by Payment Charge ID and Merchant ID

tools.name: REFUND_PAYMENT_CHARGE
tools.description: Refund all or part of an authorization on a payment charge that has been captured

amount.description: The refund amount in the payment charge currency's smallest unit.

refundDescriptor.description: The refund descriptor (arbitrary string). To provide consumer's bank account details
refundDescriptor.example: Name: Jamie Shopper CPF:12345678909 Bank Name: Scotland Bank Agency Number: 1234 Account Number: 123456789

refundReason.description: The reason for the refund request.

labels.description: Custom labels associated with the refund.

tools.description: Retrieves a Payment Charge Refund by Payment Charge ID, Refund ID and Merchant ID

tools.name: LIST_PAYMENT_CHARGE_REFUNDS
tools.description: Retrieves the Payment Charge Refunds by Payment Charge ID and Merchant ID

tools.name: VOID_PAYMENT_CHARGE
tools.description: Void all or part of an authorization on a payment charge that has not yet been captured

amount.description: The void amount in the payment charge currency's smallest unit.

labels.description: Custom labels associated with the void.

tools.description: Retrieves a Payment Charge Void by Payment Charge ID, Void ID and Merchant ID
